about.title: Engineering know-how. A commitment to getting it built right.
about.p1: Al-Solasia Building Engineering brings decades of experience in Egypt's construction sector, with a proven background in institutional projects and an expanding focus on private residential and commercial clients.
about.p2: Our approach connects practical engineering, coordinated design, and disciplined site execution — so clients understand the scope, the milestones, and the next step.
about.check2: Clear project milestones and transparent reporting
about.check4: Public, institutional, and private sector experience
about.stampText: A foundation built on experience since 1992

services.title: The right expertise at every stage of the build.
services.desc: Flexible support for owners and organizations — from early design coordination to construction, finishing, and rehabilitation.

s1.title: Design & Engineering
s1.desc: Architectural and structural design coordination, constructability reviews, and practical engineering solutions shaped around your project.

s2.title: Construction & Contracting
s2.desc: Turnkey construction delivery from foundations through reinforced concrete, structural frameworks, and coordinated handover.

s3.title: Finishing, Fit-out & Renovation
s3.desc: Interior and exterior finishing, villa and apartment renovations, and detail-focused execution for residential and commercial spaces.

s4.title: Repair & Rehabilitation
s4.desc: Structural assessment and repair planning to address defects, reinforce concrete, improve performance, and extend asset life.

s5.title: Site Supervision & Coordination
s5.desc: Rigorous site follow-up, contractor coordination, quality control, and milestone progress visibility.

s6.title: Approvals & Documentation
s6.desc: Support coordinating project documentation, authority submittals, and compliance tracking according to applicable regulations.

process.title: Good projects start with clear expectations.
process.desc: A straightforward 4-stage process helps owners understand scope, decisions, milestones, and progress before each stage begins.

step1.title: Understand
step1.desc: Discuss your goals, site location, technical requirements, and readiness.

step2.title: Define
step2.desc: Agree on the scope of work, design coordination, and project specifications.

step3.title: Plan
step3.desc: Establish milestones, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, and clear payment terms.

step4.title: Deliver
step4.desc: Execute on site, conduct quality checks, report progress, and deliver agreed handover.
